rules_files_paths.description: List of paths to Falco rules files or directories containing .yaml/.yml rules files

gvisor_enabled.description: Enable support for gvisor container runtime (requires gvisor and Falco gvisor plugin)

output_format.description: Output format: 'text' for human-readable, 'json' for structured logs

output_json_include_properties.description: Include output properties (timestamp, hostname, etc.) in JSON output

output_json_add_fields.description: Additional JSON fields to include in output (e.g., 'proc.aname', 'fd.typechar')

syscall_enabled.description: Enable capture of kernel syscall events (required for Falco’s core detection)

syscall_ebpf_enabled.description: Use the modern eBPF driver instead of legacy kernel module (recommended)

syscall_module_enabled.description: Fall back to legacy kernel module if eBPF is unavailable (avoid unless necessary)

buffers_syscalls_size.description: Size (in MB) of per-CPU syscall ring buffers. Increase if syscall events are frequently dropped

log_file_path.description: Path to Falco log file (when log_stderr=false)

metrics_enabled.description: Enable Prometheus-style metrics endpoint (requires metrics compilation)

metrics_interval.description: Metrics export interval (e.g., '5s', '1m'). Only used if metrics enabled

fim_enabled.description: Enable file integrity monitoring (FIM) — monitors changes to critical files

fim_directories.description: List of directories to monitor for file integrity changes

syscall_timeout.description: Timeout (ms) for syscall event processing before events may be dropped

json_add_fields.description: JSON output fields to append to each event

output_file_enabled.description: Enable writing raw alert events to a file

output_file_path.description: Path to write alert events (in JSON or text, depending on format)

grpc_enabled.description: Enable gRPC output (for forwarding alerts to Falcosidekick or other gRPC consumers)

grpc_server_enabled.description: Run Falco as a gRPC server (only if you want Falco to accept connections)

k8s_audit_enabled.description: Enable Kubernetes audit log monitoring (requires Kubernetes cluster)

k8s_audit_policy_path.description: Path to Kubernetes audit policy YAML file (if using Kubernetes audit logs)

k8s_audit_log_path.description: Path to Kubernetes audit log file (for file-based audit input)

k8s_audit_log_url.description: HTTP endpoint URL to stream Kubernetes audit logs (for HTTP-based audit input)
